name: SteadyStack The Initiate
free_limit: 50 monitors; 3-minute checks (1 minute for first 10); 1 public status page
watch_out: The Initiate is grandfathered to eligible early launch-cohort accounts: official pricing promises to honor launch terms permanently for early accounts, not unrestricted access to this $0 allowance for new signups. The separate 14-day trial applies to paid plans and does not make this ongoing legacy allowance a time-limited trial. Free retains logs for 3 days and includes one SteadyStack-branded public status page; official pricing explicitly permits commercial use and says no credit card is required to start.
